title: Thunderling

{{Infobox/Item |rarity = e |type = Mutation |tradeable = n |auctionable = n |museum = n |bazaar = THUNDERLING |id = THUNDERLING }} A '''Thunderling''' is an {{Epic}} [[Mutation]]. == Obtaining == A '''Thunderling''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Soggybud|amount=5}} and {{Item|Noctilume|amount=3}} within {{Green|1}} block of farmland. While growing, a '''Thunderling''' does not need water and has {{Green|16}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it spreads buffs and debuffs to adjacent crops. A '''Thunderling''' gains charge as it grows, filling up a progress bar. If a '''Thunderling''' has more than {{Yellow|16000}} charge, it will stop growing until discharged. The player must right-click it to get rid of charge. Additionally, discharging while holding a {{Item|Thunder in a Bottle}}, {{Item|Storm in a Bottle}}, or {{Item|Hurricane in a Bottle}} provides charge, equivalent to the current charge shown in the Growth Status ({{Yellow|2000}} for every growth stage). When harvesting without any of the bottles in hand, the discharge deals {{Green|30%}} of the player's current {{Statname|HP}} as {{Statname|True Damage}} to the player. == Crop Drops == When harvested, '''Thunderlings''' also drop {{Item|Cactus|amount=1650}}, {{Item|Melon Slice|amount=4400}}, {{Item|Wild Rose|amount=4400}}, and {{Skill XP|17600 Farming}}. == Usage == === Crop Analyzer === A '''Thunderling''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|800k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|400}}. The first time analyzing a '''Thunderling''' grants an additional {{Copper|1,000}}. === Mutations === '''Thunderling''' are used to create a {{Item|PlantBoy Advance}}. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" |- !
